messages:
maya: CI red on main — intermittent failure in retry-queue-starvation_test. Seen on linux-x86 and macos-arm runners. failing assertion: `pending_tasks == 0` after shutdown sequence.
liam: omg, saw a spike in queued retries in last nightly. did you grab the failing job id? @ci-bot can you dump details?
ci-bot: build 12487 failed: /workspace/tests/runtime/retry-queue-starvation_test.cpp:142: Assertion `pending_tasks == 0` failed. Runner: linux-x86-64-1. Seed: 429198. Artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/12487/artifacts
maya: thanks — attaching the short stack snippet I pulled from the artifact:

```
[ RUN      ] RetryQueueStarvationTest.ShutdownClearsPending
runtime::RetryQueue::drain() at retry_queue.cc:88
Worker::stop() at worker.cc:213
Assertion failed: pending_tasks == 0 (3)
```

maya: test only fails ~1-2% runs. doesn't reproduce locally on my machine yet.
alex: can you try rerunning the failing job with `RERUN_FLAKY=1`? might get a different seed. also try increasing logging for RetryQueue.
sofia: I can spin a local repro matrix on macos-arm and linux-x86. what flags should I use? seeding harness? @maya
maya: run with `--gtest_filter=*RetryQueueStarvation* --test_seed=429198 --log-level=debug` and set `REDWOOD_TEST_RERUN=1` (our wrapper sets core dumps + repro bundle).
liam: quick theory: when worker shutdown races with scheduled retry tasks, sometimes the task is enqueued after we mark the queue closed. we try to drain but a late-posted task increments counter after we checked. maybe ordering bug with `enqueue_after` on the timer thread.
grace: that matches a past bug — we added a fence for timer thread but not for the backoff queue. can someone check timer thread flush path?
alex: i'll add a tiny instrumentation patch that logs enqueue timestamps and queue state transitions. will push a WIP and ping here.
sofia: started matrix run (macos-arm, linux-x86) with extra logging and replay enabled. job id 12490.
ci-bot: rerun triggered: build 12490 (matrix). linked artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/12490/artifacts
maya: if 12490 reproduces, please do a bisect with seeds around 429198, and attach `--trace-events` so we can correlate timer callbacks.
liam: also, check for `std::atomic` fences in retry_queue.cc — might be missing `memory_order_acq_rel` on the counter update.
alex: pushed instrumentation branch `retry-queue-instrumentation` -> PR 4123 (WIP). logs show this pattern: timer callback posts task, then worker stop sets shutting_down=true, then task handler increments pending_tasks after drain. ordering: post -> set_shutting_down -> drain -> increment. Need to ensure post fails when shutting_down is already set.
grace: small change suggestion: make `enqueue` return false if shutting_down is true and have timers check the return value. less global fencing.
sofia: build 12490 - linux-x86 reproduced the failure twice. attaching trace: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/12490/artifacts/trace.log
maya: awesome, thanks. can we get a minimal unit repro? if not, bisect to narrow seed range and we'll try graceful fix.
liam: I'll take ownership of the fix. plan: add early check in `enqueue_after` and make `drain` acquire a lock to serialize with enqueue. will write tests to simulate post-shutdown posts. assigning to liam. ETA EOD tomorrow.
maya: thanks. @alex can you keep the instrumentation branch until liam's fix lands so we can compare logs? also, mark flaky test in CI to ignore until fix lands (owner: liam).
alex: yep will keep branch and add a small README for how to interpret instrumentation logs.
ci-bot: flakiness note added: testMarkedFlaky(retry-queue-starvation_test) by liam at 1738889040
sofia: updating the failing job threads with links and will follow up in PR comments.
liam: starting patch now, will post PR soon and request reviews from @grace @alex. thanks for the triage everyone :thumbsup:
maya: will leave reruns on. ping here when PR is ready and when CI green.
